title: Composite of finite ring maps is finite (Stacks 00GL)
statement: Let $R\to S$ and $S\to T$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings such that $S$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $T$ is a finitely generated $S$-module. Then $T$ is a finitely generated $R$-module via the composite $R\to S\to T$: if $s_1,\dots,s_m$ generate $S$ over $R$ and $t_1,\dots,t_n$ generate $T$ over $S$, the products $s_it_j$ generate $T$ over $R$.
